notes: Exponent pi^2 Ne/T reproduces; Day's 'seventy-eight-millionth' is 77.15 million decades at Ne/T = 1.8e7 (78.2 million at Ne = 7.3e9, T = 400), a 1% rounding. The exact diffusion F carries a prefactor that Day's form omits: 47x at T = Ne, which matches Day's own simulation (7.4 expected, 6 observed; his formula gives 0.16). Which window and Ne apply is the dispute; under the lineage window F ranges 0.017 to 1.
